title: Your Taxes panel
description: The #your-taxes section: a stacked bar visual showing how a property tax bill divides between governing bodies, and four explainer blocks describing what each body's share funds. Created because generateTaxSection had no data source — the bar widths, percentage labels and explainer copy existed only as markup and appeared in no JSON file. Prose fields accept the safe HTML subset and {{fact:<id>}} tokens.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

note.description: The caveat block under the bars. Carries the sourcing state of each share — which percentages are confirmed, which are not — and the Receiver of Taxes phone number for an individual breakdown.

bars.description: DISPLAY ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER, largest share first.

explainers.description: DISPLAY ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER. Deliberately a different order from `bars` — the pre-refactor page listed the bars as school/village/county/town but the explainers as school/county/village/town. Kept as two independent arrays rather than forced into one order.

label.description: Row name as printed, without the icon.

percent_text.description: The text printed at the right of the row — NOT a number, because three of the four shares are not published figures. Real values include 'largest share*', 'est. — verify*' and '~3–5%'. Keep the hedging: only the village share has a source.

bar_width.description: PRESENTATION ONLY — the CSS width percentage of the filled bar. This is NOT data and must never be read back as a tax percentage. The four current widths (60/25/12/4) sum to 101 and only the village figure corresponds to a sourced number; the others are illustrative proportions chosen to look right. If a genuine published breakdown ever exists, add it as facts and render percent_text from those, but keep this field separate.

fill_style.description: Bar colour; renders as CSS class .bar-<value>. Must match an existing rule in the stylesheet.

governing_body.description: Foreign key to bodies.json id. Null for a row covering more than one body, e.g. 'Village (Pelham or Manor)'.

description.description: What this body's share of the bill actually funds. Safe HTML subset plus {{fact:<id>}} tokens — write {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}}, never a literal dollar figure.

accent.description: Block accent colour; renders as CSS class .<value> on .tax-explainer-block ('none' emits no extra class). Presentation only, and deliberately not aligned to the bar colours — the pre-refactor page used a different colour per block than per bar.

link.description: The source link at the foot of the block.
